name: OR-Library (Beasley)
description: OR-Library is a broad collection of test data sets for a wide range of operations research problems, originally distributed by J. E. Beasley via electronic mail. It spans bin packing, set covering and set partitioning, multidimensional knapsack, p-median and facility location, generalized assignment, Steiner trees, crew scheduling, TSP, vehicle routing, and the classic job-shop and flow-shop scheduling instances (including the Fisher-Thompson ft06/ft10/ft20 and Lawrence LA sets). Each problem family ships with reference solutions or bounds, so algorithms are scored against known optima or best-known values.
typical_sota_score: Problem-dependent; many smaller instances are solved to optimality while larger packing/scheduling/covering instances remain benchmarks for heuristics.
reputation: A long-standing and widely cited repository of OR test problems; the source of many canonical instances reused across decades of metaheuristic and exact-solver papers.
notes: Not an LLM benchmark; a heterogeneous collection of classical OR instances. Because it bundles many problem families, results are reported per family rather than as a single aggregate score. The scheduling sets overlap with dedicated job-shop/flow-shop benchmarks.
